endorsements.name: Garry Pejski
endorsements.label: My Life As A Spyware Developer
endorsements.description: Behold! Billions of computers are infected with spyware every decade! But how! And why! Let's join our host as he takes you behind the curtain of the mysterious spyware industry. This will be a high level discussion with no technical knowledge needed. I'll be covering how I ended up writing spyware, what the software was capable of, how it was deployed onto millions of machines, how all the money was made (not how you'd expect) and how it all fell apart (of course). After seeing this talk, all your dreams will come true and you will never die!
endorsements.subtitle: DEF CON 18
